title: xdssat rice simulation, java, per_cell calendar
summary: Seasonal DSSAT-CSM rice results on the AgERA5 0.1 degree grid, one simulation per weather cell and water regime, with rice area for area-weighted totals.
source: DSSAT-CSM 4.8 CERES-Rice (RICER048), engine dssat; template XDRI8601.RIX; weather AgERA5 (https://doi.org/10.24381/cds.6c68c9bb); soil SoilGrids 2.0 with Saxton-Rawls (2006) hydraulics; rice area ATR/BPN 2024; irrigation class Ministry of Agriculture
comment: Uncalibrated: one cultivar (IR 58), 140 kg N as urea, no pests or diseases; not comparable with farm statistics until calibrated.
